albums.title: The Azeezs
albums.description: A family session in a park at peak autumn colour, shot at golden hour with low sun coming through the trees and a carpet of fallen leaves. A mix of the whole family, each parent with the kids, the siblings together and a few frames of just the couple.

albums.title: Tharif & Zahraa
albums.description: A pre-shoot in a park under a moody overcast sky, with the bride in red and gold and the groom in a black tuxedo, moving from tree-lined paths to a wooden deck over a pond with an umbrella for the drizzle. The reception follows in a chandelier-lit banquet hall with a pastel floral stage, a staircase entrance and the cake cutting.

albums.title: Jalen & Wardah
albums.description: An all-white nikkah in a bright, curtained hall filled with white florals: the bride arriving under an embroidered veil, the signing, the veil lift and ring exchange, then cake, family and a rainy night send-off under umbrellas.

albums.title: Manmit & Vikita — The Proposal
albums.description: An evening proposal in a field edged with pines, with a red carpet leading to light-up MARRY ME letters. I stayed through dusk for the ring, the champagne, a sky lantern and fireworks over their silhouettes.

albums.title: Shakir & Umaima
albums.description: A nikkah at a mosque followed by a waleema in a banquet hall. The bride arrives veiled in white for the ring exchange, then the two of them step out in lilac and grey-blue for golden-hour portraits in a garden gazebo and a red carriage before the stage and hall coverage.

albums.title: Ameer & Shaafin
albums.description: A nikkah in a white banquet hall with a pale floral arch on stage. The groom signs with the imam and his father beside him, the bride walks in under a red veil, and after the veil is lifted they trade rings and I took them out to the lobby and staircase for portraits, both in white.

albums.title: Mohsin & Rida
albums.description: Three days with one couple: a mehndi in orange and pink with sunlit park portraits, a white-gown and green-tuxedo shoot around a stone estate with formal gardens and a long reflecting pool, and a red and gold wedding day with portraits by the water in hard afternoon sun.

albums.title: Sidrah
albums.description: A mehndi evening for a bride in hot pink, teal and purple. We started with portraits on the platform of a small heritage train station in soft evening light, then moved inside to a marigold-and-tassel floral arch where family took turns feeding her sweets.

albums.title: Mohid & Abrar
albums.description: A nikkah signed at a mosque community hall and a small hall celebration afterwards, both in ivory and champagne outfits. Quiet portraits against a plain wall and on a carved wooden swing, henna and ring details, garlands, cake and a lot of family warmth.

albums.title: Hana & Amman
albums.description: A casual couple shoot on foot through a downtown core on a bright summer day: plazas, crosswalks, brick alleys, a graffiti wall and glass towers, both of them in matching brown and cream. It runs from hard midday sun to softer evening light, ending with him lifting her between the black towers.

albums.title: Nurah & Hamaz
albums.description: A summer wedding day that starts with portraits in a park, the bride in red and gold and the groom in a black embroidered sherwani among pergolas, evergreens and a rock waterfall. It moves indoors to a white-and-gold draped stage, a packed dance floor, a tearful rukhsati and a send-off with fireworks.

albums.title: Hana & Amman — The Proposal
albums.description: A surprise proposal in a park gazebo, set with rose petals, candles and a neon "Will you marry me?" sign. I followed it from her walk across the lawn to the moment he knelt, then took the two of them down a wooded trail for portraits.

albums.title: Subhani & Dhivian
albums.description: A Hindu temple wedding that starts with the bride getting ready at home in a gold saree and soft window light, then moves to a white and green mandap for the ceremony. Lots of colour, garlands and family blessings, finishing with portraits of the couple against the temple's carved doors.

albums.title: Ahad & Emily
albums.description: A pre-wedding haldi and mehndi day at home: gifts and jewellery carried in on trays, turmeric smeared on both of them by a room full of family in bright orange, pink and blue, then henna and an evening in the garden. Loud colour, rose petals on the floor and a lot of laughing.

albums.title: Haseenah & Farahaz
albums.description: A mehndi in mustard yellow and turquoise: couple portraits around an ivy-covered stone manor and its gardens before sunset, then a hall dressed in orange, teal and pink drapes for the entrances, cake, family photos on the swing stage and a long night of dancing.

albums.title: Osama & Hajra — Waleema
albums.description: An outdoor summer wedding on a farm property, with portraits against a red barn, under a big tree with a tyre swing and beside a pond in bright midday sun. The bride wore sage green with a long veil, and the day ran from a white floral stage on the lawn through the shoe game to a tearful send-off.

albums.title: Osama & Hajra — Nikkah
albums.description: A spring nikkah in ivory and gold: portraits under a wooden pergola, beside tulip beds and a rock waterfall, then a white tent on a farm property with a greenery-wrapped stage. I followed the bride walking in under a floral canopy with her veil down, the signing, the veil lift and the ring exchange.

albums.title: Subhani & Dhivian — Pre-Shoot
albums.description: A couple's session in three outfits: a magenta saree and navy suit on the rocks at the water's edge under an overcast sky, then softer evening light by a marsh, a white truss footbridge and a graffiti-lined underpass, finishing with a relaxed walk along a wooded path.

albums.title: Osama & Hajra — The Proposal
albums.description: A beach proposal in bright midday sun: a gold hoop arch and light-up letters set on the sand by the water, him in a navy suit going down on one knee, her in a pale blue dress with red roses. Afterwards we walked the shoreline for ring close-ups, a sparkling toast on the rocks and a few frames in a wooden gazebo.

albums.title: Yunus & Safiyyah
albums.description: Two couple sessions in wedding attire by the water: the nikkah outfits on a rocky shoreline under a clear blue sky, then the white gown and dark green tuxedo along a waterfront boardwalk and park. Bright afternoon sun, lots of movement, twirls and close, laughing frames.

albums.title: Haseenah & Farahaz — Portraits
albums.description: A late-autumn wedding-day portrait session in ivory and gold among carved stone arches and bare trees, starting with a first look and ending beside a white Jeep. Soft overcast light, with close details of her henna and wrist corsage.

albums.title: Hasnain & Zeba
albums.description: A nikkah in a banquet hall with a white floral stage: the bride's entrance under a canopy of flowers, the ceremony, cake, bhangra dancers and a first dance in low fog. Before it, I photographed the two of them in silver, white and deep green around a log cabin and a leafy summer park.
